'''Darl Coplin''' is a farmer from [[Emond's Field]] in the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Darl Coplin}}

== Appearance ==
He has a narrow, weasel-like face with a tight mouth and is a known troublemaker.

== Activities ==
He is suspected of scrawling the [[Dragon's Fang]] on [[Brandelwyn al'Vere]]'s door. He confronts [[Moiraine Damodred]] with a crowd behind him, demanding she leaves [[Emond's Field]] at once.

He shoots at a group of Tuatha'an, mistaking them somehow for Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|45}}

He helps defend Emond's Field against the invading [[Trolloc]]s. He takes a spear to the thigh during the final battle with the Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|56}}

He is one of the [[Two Rivers]] men to follow [[Perrin Aybara]] into [[Ghealdan]]. He is one of the guards on duty watching for any [[Children of the Light]] activity.
